userStories.title: Audit pricing CTA wiring in frontend
userStories.description: Inspect the current pricing card/button flow in groovesheet-fe. Verify where Pricing.js is rendered, whether /pricing exists, how login gating works, and what endpoint or action pricing buttons currently call. Append concise findings to progress.txt before making changes.

userStories.title: Implement logged-in pricing button flow
userStories.description: Make pricing buttons behave correctly for authenticated users in groovesheet-fe. If backend purchase/credit fulfillment already exists, wire pricing CTAs to that flow. If frontend-only fixes are possible, implement them. If backend work is required beyond this repo, document the exact blocker and safest frontend-side changes in progress.txt.
